prompts.emblem: Use case: logo-brand. Create one clean imperial beacon-keeper emblem for a Korean HD-2D medieval wall-defense game. Transparent background. A SIMPLE straight-on stylized lighthouse: sturdy tapered navy tower, brass lantern window with one small pale-gold light, navy low pyramidal lantern cap, three short straight gold rays on either side above shoulders, two short brass steps at the base. Restrained heraldic symbol, no surrounding shield or circle, no lettering, no ornaments, no gradients, no glow, no shadow. Square canvas, single centered emblem occupies 75 percent. Crisp hard pixel edges on a logical 32 by 32 pixel grid enlarged evenly, very readable in a 64x64 UI icon. Three shades of muted brass/gold and navy, dark 1 logical pixel outer edges. Navy #172334 #29394d and brass #a47836 #d1aa58 #efcf85. This exact emblem will also be used as golden embroidery on navy banners, so simple silhouette and clear lantern opening are critical.
prompts.lamp: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel sprite sheet on genuine transparent background. ONE SINGLE HORIZONTAL ROW of SEVEN equally spaced front-view identical road lamp posts. First post UNLIT daytime, remaining SIX posts lit with six slightly different crisp flame poses inside the cage. Seven equal cells, same size, top and bottom and center aligned. No text, no floor, no cast shadow, no glow, no smoke, no ambient light halo. The post is short and sturdy, about 1.6m, native sprite silhouette only 22px wide by 51px high, draw logical crisp chunky pixels enlarged evenly about 8x. Small square grey limestone plinth, tapered wrought-iron black post with one collar, simple functional cage lantern with four straight dark bars, squat peaked rain cap and small finial. Broad readable primitive shapes, no thin curly flourishes. Upper-left light, 3 material shading steps, dark 1 logical pixel outline. Warm brass fasteners at joints, graphite blue iron, weathered desaturated grey stone. Unlit lantern cavity dark cool translucent glass with visible empty wick; lit six posts have amber flame, orange outer tongue and pale gold inner 2px core fully INSIDE dark cage. For animation, cage/post/stone must stay EXACTLY unchanged; only flame and glass light vary. No floating embers. A serious Octopath Traveler style restrained sprite, NEVER glossy, painterly, blurred or high-detail pseudo-pixel. All seven centered in equal cells with generous transparent margins.
prompts.banner: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference image is the APPROVED emblem design only, NOT the output subject. Generate transparent PNG production PIXEL SPRITE SHEET, ONE HORIZONTAL ROW of FOUR equal cells of the SAME tall navy beacon-order banner on a dark iron POLE and CROSSBAR with small gold finial, complete small square stone base. Front view camera-facing billboard, not isometric. The entire full freestanding pole with base measures logical 58 pixels tall, cloth about 19px wide by 32px high, total width about 25px. Draw as enlarged crisp logical pixels. FOUR distinct phases of a GENTLE breeze wave loop: cloth curls +1px, neutral, -1px, neutral with differing lower folds. Base, pole, finial and crossbar must stay EXACTLY identical in all four frames. Brass trimmed navy cloth with a simple pointed hem. Center embroidered GOLD silhouette of the reference lighthouse with roof, bright small lantern, sturdy tapered tower, two steps, and THREE short rays on each side. Make same emblem in all four frames, readable in a 12x17 logical pixel region, brass gold only against navy. No shields, letters, stars, crowns, tassels, foliage or decorative clutter. Matte navy cloth 3 shades #172334 #29394d #3f5265, muted warm brass #a47836 #d1aa58 #efcf85. Strong upper-left light, dark one-logical-pixel outline, chunky pixels. No gradients, glow, soft shadow, ground plane. All 4 pole bases rest on identical baseline, each pole at same horizontal cell center with generous transparent gutters. Transparent background truly empty.
prompts.pennant: Production sprite asset sheet, transparent background, four frames in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, no text. SMALL TRIANGULAR PENNANT FLAG ON SHORT VERTICAL IRON POLE. This is NOT a rectangular hanging banner. Each flag is a HORIZONTAL RIGHT-POINTING TRIANGLE: attached along its short vertical LEFT edge to the TOP of a pole, and narrows to a single sharp point at its RIGHT tip. No horizontal crossbar. No hanging rectangle. Flag proportions triangle width 19 logical pixels, triangle height 13 pixels. Pole extends down from left edge to a tiny stone base, full asset height32 pixels. The flag is navy cloth, thin brass perimeter hem, with a tiny simple GOLD lighthouse symbol with two rays at center. Emblem reference is design guidance only. 4 gentle wave frames, only triangle tip moves 1px up/down with slight folds. Short pole and base identical fixed positions. Crisp enlarged chunky logical pixels, dark 1px outline, three shades matte navy and muted brass, upper left light, no blur, no glow, no gradients, no textures, no text. Generous clear spacing, all four bases on same line and pole at same relative x in each equal cell.
prompts.wall: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference 1 is beacon emblem, reference 2 the freestanding main banner design and sprite style. Create WALL-MOUNTED banner variant for courtyard buildings on transparent background: ONE ROW FOUR FRAMES of same navy banner cloth on a short horizontal wrought-iron crossbar fixed to wall by two visible small brass mounting plates. No full ground pole, NO stone base, NO wall behind it. Front-facing billboard pixel art logical silhouette 24px wide by 40px tall enlarged evenly. Rectangular navy hanging cloth, gently pointed bottom hem, narrow brass trim, central simple brass lighthouse/lamp with roof, window, stepped tower base and three short light rays on each side. Four subtle gentle wave phases right,center,left,center. The mounting brackets and crossbar must be EXACTLY unchanged in all frames with identical registration. Three shade matte navy + muted brass, upper-left lighting, chunky hard 1px outlined pixels. Keep fabric geometry clean and purposeful, no tassels or decorative filigree. No glow or gradients, no background shadow, no text. Generous transparent gutters and all four frames equal size and aligned.
prompts.glow: Use case: stylized-concept. Create just one ground illumination decal texture on genuine transparent background. Square canvas. A single extremely restrained warm amber circular soft light pool centered exactly in the image. Top down radial texture intended to lie FLAT on a 3D paved ground plane, NOT an ellipse preprojected for camera. Subtle pale amber center fading smoothly to zero alpha before outer 12 percent canvas margins. No hard ring, no opaque disc, NO black background, no lantern, no objects, no sparks, no rays, no flare, no bright white spot, no bloom fog. Uniform amber hue throughout, vary only opacity, low opacity peak about 18 percent so road texture remains readable underneath. This is an intentionally soft separate decal, unlike the crisp pixel lantern sprite.
